summary: Markets are navigating choppy conditions as Treasury yields stabilize after a volatile week that saw the US Treasury announce expanded long-term debt buybacks in a bid to calm bond markets. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq posted weekly losses despite a Friday bounce, with tech stocks bearing the brunt of the sell-off as the 30-year yield hit multi-decade highs before the intervention. Crypto markets surged dramatically, with Bitcoin jumping above $76,000 and Ethereum rallying over 25% in three days after President Trump pushed Congress to pass the Clarity Act and Treasury buybacks injected liquidity into risk assets. Meanwhile, Fed Chair Kevin Warsh held rates steady at 3.5-3.75% in July despite three hawkish dissents, keeping investors on edge ahead of next week's PCE inflation data and Nvidia earnings on August 26. Geopolitical risk is rising as Trump vowed 'economic warfare' against Iran, pushing oil prices higher and adding to inflation concerns.

signals.title: Treasury Buyback Plan Sparks Crypto Rally
signals.desc: US Treasury doubled long-term debt buybacks, suppressing yields and injecting liquidity that fueled Bitcoin's 18% three-day surge to $76,700 and Ethereum's 25% rally.

signals.title: Trump Pushes Crypto Clarity Act
signals.desc: President Trump urged Congress to pass crypto legislation defining regulatory framework, boosting sentiment and driving institutional risk appetite toward digital assets.

signals.title: Bond Volatility Hammers Tech Stocks
signals.desc: 30-year Treasury yield spike to near-20-year highs pressured growth stocks; Meta down 7% for the week, with tech sector shedding 3% despite Friday rebound.

signals.title: Fed Holds Steady with Hawkish Dissents
signals.desc: FOMC kept rates at 3.5-3.75% in July but three members dissented in favor of a hike, signaling ongoing inflation vigilance ahead of September decision.

signals.title: Trump Iran Threats Lift Oil, Inflation Risks
signals.desc: President announced 'economic warfare' against Iran, sending crude higher and raising stagflation fears that could force Fed to delay rate cuts.

verdict: Risk-on rotation into crypto and commodities continues as Treasury intervention eases immediate bond stress, but elevated yields and geopolitical tensions keep equity upside capped ahead of key data and Nvidia earnings.
